for quashing of Fir No.90, dated 12.06.2024, under Sections 420, 406, 370 Ipc, at Police Station
Naggal, District Ambala, (Annexure P-1) P and subsequent proceedings arising therefrom on the
basis of compromise dated 16.09.2025 (Annexure P-2).
2.

3. Pursuant to the aforesaid order, parties have appeared before the Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Ambala and got their statements recorded.
